patch_description:
This version adds a KVPR-threshold packing phase. For a target pressure `p`, each model is transformed into a bin-packing size:

`model_size + (req_rate / slo) / p`

If transformed models fit in an 80 GB bin, that GPU is guaranteed to have KVPR at most `p`. The algorithm binary-searches useful pressure thresholds, tries several transformed packing orders, evaluates every successful assignment by its true KVPR, and retains the best result instead of accepting the first feasible packing.

It also preserves diversified greedy constructions and improves every candidate using relocations and swaps. Candidate comparison is lexicographic: minimum maximum KVPR, then minimum second-highest pressure, then maximum remaining GPU memory.
